name: add_leads
title: Add Campaign Leads
description: Add public profile vanity URLs to a campaign; no browser is used.

name: approve_batch
title: Approve Campaign Batch
description: Approve visible items. The server issues the token and recomputes hashes.

name: archive_conversation
title: Archive Conversation
description:
Archive one LinkedIn messaging thread, InMail included, by thread ID.

Opens the thread, which marks it read, and chooses Archive from its
options menu. A thread LinkedIn already files as archived is left
alone and reported already_archived, so a repeated call clicks
nothing. The change is confirmed by loading the thread again.
Reversible on LinkedIn; a new message moves the thread back to the
inbox.

thread_id.description:
LinkedIn messaging thread ID, as get_inbox,
search_conversations or get_conversation return it

name: campaign_status
title: Campaign Status
description: Report local campaign states, pause and stale approvals.

name: close_session
title: Close Session
description: Close the current browser session and clean up resources.

name: connect_with_person
title: Connect With Person
description:
Send a LinkedIn connection request or accept an incoming one.

The tool is annotated with destructiveHint so MCP clients will
prompt for user confirmation before execution.

linkedin_username.description: LinkedIn username (e.g., "stickerdaniel", "williamhgates"). A full profile URL is accepted too and is reduced to the username.

note.description: Optional note to include with the invitation

dry_run.description: Resolve the recipient and prepare the invitation, then dismiss it before sending.

name: create_campaign
title: Create Campaign
description: Create a local prospecting campaign. This never opens LinkedIn.

name: create_post
title: Create Post
description:
Publish a feed post, or preview and discard it with dry_run=True.

The text must have 1 to 3000 characters. An optional local PNG, JPEG,
GIF or WebP image can be attached. Visibility defaults to current,
LinkedIn's existing composer audience; requested anyone or connections
is refused because the audience cannot be verified without reading a
locale-dependent label. A published result carries published=True,
post_url (the /feed/update/<urn>/ permalink) and urn. A result with
retry_safe=False means the Post click may have happened: inspect
profile activity before attempting another publication.

name: dismiss_job
title: Dismiss Job
description:
Dismiss a job from LinkedIn job search so later searches never show it.

For jobs already applied to or rejected. Reads the job's title and
company from its posting, clicks the dismiss button on its card in a
worldwide search for them, then reloads that search to confirm the job
is gone. Irreversible: LinkedIn offers no undo after a reload. A job
that search does not list on its first page is an error, since an
already dismissed job and a search that missed it look the same.

name: export_campaign
title: Export Campaign
description: Export campaign rows as CSV or JSON text; no file is written.

name: get_company_employees
title: Get Company Employees
description:
List employees at a company from the LinkedIn /people/ page, including
the demographics aggregate that this view exposes: where employees
live, where they studied, and a function breakdown (Engineering, Sales,
Operations, etc.). The demographics are unique to this tool.

For filtered search by network degree (1st/2nd/3rd) or location, prefer
search_people with current_company set to the company URN id. That path
also returns more result pages than the /people/ tab.

The optional keywords filter narrows results by name, title, or skill.

company_name must be the exact LinkedIn URL slug (the path segment after
/company/), not the display name. LinkedIn assigns unique slugs and the
display name often does not match. For example, the AI lab Anthropic
lives at /company/anthropicresearch/, not /company/anthropic/. If you
are unsure of the slug, call search_companies first and pick the slug
from the returned references.

company_name.description: LinkedIn company URL slug (e.g., "docker", "anthropicresearch", "microsoft"). A full company URL is accepted too and is reduced to the slug.

keywords.description: Optional filter by name, job title, or skill (e.g., "engineer", "sales")

name: get_company_posts
title: Get Company Posts
description: Get recent posts from a company's LinkedIn feed.

company_name.description: LinkedIn company name (e.g., "docker", "anthropic", "microsoft"). A full company URL is accepted too and is reduced to the slug.

max_scrolls.description:
Maximum scroll-to-bottom iterations to load more posts.
Default (None) uses 10. Increase to read further back in the feed.

name: get_company_profile
title: Get Company Profile
description: Get a specific company's LinkedIn profile.

company_name.description: LinkedIn company name (e.g., "docker", "anthropic", "microsoft"). A full company URL is accepted too and is reduced to the slug.

sections.description:
Comma-separated list of extra sections to read.
The about page is always included.
Available sections: posts, jobs
Examples: "posts", "posts,jobs"
Default (None) reads only the about page.

name: get_conversation
title: Get Conversation
description:
Read a specific messaging conversation.

Provide either linkedin_username or thread_id to identify the conversation.

When looked up by linkedin_username, resolution compares the profile
card heading with each row's visible participant name (or the name
inside a known en, pt-BR or de aria-label when the visible text is
that sentence). Names match after one normalization: collapsed
whitespace, casefold, full string. A label in no known format is an
error that quotes the label; it is not reported as a missing
conversation. The browser locale is not an input.

Matching rows are click-visited to capture thread IDs — the sidebar
has no anchor hrefs or thread-id attributes. Each visit may mark that
thread read. Pass thread_id to open one thread without scanning.

The indexable sequence ends before the first unresolved click, missing
matching click target, or admitted row that fails the display-name
check. An index outside that verified prefix is refused with its
reason. Search is a fallback only when the inbox scan has no observed
matching result and no such barrier.

linkedin_username.description: LinkedIn username of the conversation participant; a full profile URL is accepted too

index.description:
0-based selector for which thread to open when the
participant has multiple threads (e.g. an organic 1-on-1 plus
an InMail). Ignored when thread_id is provided. To enumerate
thread IDs first, call search_conversations.

name: get_easy_apply_form
title: Get Easy Apply Form
description:
Read the questions of a job posting's Easy Apply form, without answering them.

Opens Easy Apply and reads each step: every field's label, type, whether
it is required, its options, character limit and prefilled value. Next
is clicked only while LinkedIn accepts a step on its prefilled values,
so the first step that needs input ends the read. Nothing is typed,
Review and Submit are never clicked, and the dialog is closed with its
draft discarded.

name: get_feed
title: Get Feed
description: Get posts from the authenticated user's LinkedIn feed.

num_posts.description:
Number of posts to fetch (1-50, default 10).
       Posts are loaded in batches of ~5 as the page scrolls,
       so the actual count may slightly exceed the target.

name: get_inbox
title: Get Inbox
description:
List recent conversations from the LinkedIn messaging inbox.

Read from the compose page, which does not open a thread on its own.
Rows are not clicked, so other conversations are not marked read.
previews lists each visible row. thread_id is null when the row has no
thread link — the list does not carry one, and discovering it would
mean clicking the row. Open one thread with get_conversation; that
open is the click, and it marks that thread read. Anchor references,
when the page has any, keep their normal handling.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversation previews to return (1-50, default 20)

name: get_job_apply_url
title: Get Job Apply URL
description:
Get how a job posting takes applications, and the employer's application link.

Reads the posting without clicking anything.

name: get_job_details
title: Get Job Details
description: Get job details for a specific job posting on LinkedIn.

name: get_my_profile
title: Get My Profile
description:
Get the authenticated user's own LinkedIn profile.

Navigates to /in/me/ and resolves the redirect to obtain the real
username before reading the profile, so the url field in the result is the actual
profile URL (e.g. linkedin.com/in/johndoe/) rather than /in/me/.

sections.description:
Comma-separated list of extra sections to read.
The main profile page is always included.
Available sections: experience, education, interests, honors, volunteering, languages, certifications, skills, projects, contact_info, posts
Examples: "experience,education", "contact_info", "skills,projects"
Default (None) reads only the main profile page.

max_scrolls.description: Maximum pagination attempts per section (same as get_person_profile).

name: get_person_profile
title: Get Person Profile
description: Get a specific person's LinkedIn profile.

linkedin_username.description: LinkedIn username (e.g., "stickerdaniel", "williamhgates"). A full profile URL is accepted too and is reduced to the username.

sections.description:
Comma-separated list of extra sections to read.
The main profile page is always included.
Available sections: experience, education, interests, honors, volunteering, languages, certifications, skills, projects, contact_info, posts
Examples: "experience,education", "contact_info", "skills,projects", "honors,languages", "posts"
Default (None) reads only the main profile page.

max_scrolls.description:
Maximum pagination attempts per section to load more content.
On detail sections (experience, certifications, skills, etc.) this
is the max number of "Show more" button clicks. On activity/posts
it is the max scroll-to-bottom iterations. Applies to all sections
in this call. Default (None) uses 5 for detail sections and 10 for
posts. Increase when a profile has many items in a section
(e.g., 30+ certifications, max_scrolls=20). To avoid slowing down
other sections, request heavy sections in a separate call.

name: get_prospecting_limits
title: Get Prospecting Limits
description:
Report local daily caps and the active weekly prospecting cap.

Reads only the local daily counter and the configured caps
(--daily-invite-limit, --daily-message-limit); it opens no browser and
sends nothing. It includes profile visits, Sales Navigator page loads,
and weekly invite counts.
A limit of 0 means unlimited and reports remaining as null.

name: get_saved_jobs
title: Get Saved Jobs
description:
List the authenticated user's jobs at one stage of LinkedIn's job tracker.

Returns job_ids that can be passed to get_job_details for full info.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of tracker pages to load (1-10, default 3)

stage.description:
Tracker tab: saved (default), in_progress, applied or
archived. applied lists Easy Apply submissions and external
applications the user confirmed to LinkedIn.

name: get_session_status
title: Get Session Status
description:
Report local saved-session and serving-process state for requested diagnostics.

Reads local observations without opening a browser, starting setup or login,
or contacting LinkedIn. Stored files do not prove current authentication.
In shared-browser mode these observations belong to the owner, not to a
frontend running a login. It answers during browser work without refreshing
the browser idle timer. Use ordinary LinkedIn tools directly for their
requested work rather than adding a status preflight.

name: get_sidebar_profiles
title: Get Sidebar Profiles
description:
Get profile links from sidebar recommendation sections on a LinkedIn profile page.

Extracts profiles from "More profiles for you", "Explore premium profiles",
and "People you may know" sidebar sections. Follows "Show all" links to
return the full list from each section. Sections that redirect to
linkedin.com/premium are skipped.

linkedin_username.description:
LinkedIn username of the profile page to read; a full profile URL is accepted too
(e.g., "stickerdaniel", "williamhgates")

name: preview_batch
title: Preview Campaign Batch
description: Show the exact item hashes that an explicit approval would cover.

name: reply_to_conversation
title: Reply to Conversation
description:
Reply inside an existing LinkedIn messaging thread, InMail included.

Opens /messaging/thread/<thread_id>/ and types into that thread's own
reply composer, so the message lands in the same conversation. This is
the path for answering a recruiter InMail, whose sender may have no
Message action on their profile. Get the thread_id from get_inbox,
search_conversations or get_conversation.

The thread is verified before anything is typed: the page must land on
exactly the requested thread and stay there, and the composer must be
the page's one visible editor, inside the thread's main region, with
one submit button in its own form. Any doubt fails closed. Quick-reply
buttons an InMail shows ("Yes, interested...", "No thanks...") are
never clicked; a thread that offers only those has no composer and
returns composer_unavailable. A draft already in the composer is left
untouched and returns composer_occupied. A ``status`` of
``enter_to_send_enabled`` means LinkedIn's "Press Enter to Send"
preference hides the Send button; relay the returned instructions as
for send_message. The dry run reports it too. No Voyager or other
private API is used. This is a write operation when confirm_send is
True.

thread_id.description:
LinkedIn messaging thread ID, or a /messaging/thread/<id>/
reference as another tool returned it

message.description:
Message text, read as send_message reads it: LF, CRLF and
CR all end a line, empty lines are kept, and the whole message
is trimmed. Tab, other control characters, DEL, U+0085, U+2028
and U+2029 are refused.

confirm_send.description:
Must be True to send. False is a dry run that verifies
the thread and composer, types nothing, and says who the reply
would go to.

name: sales_nav_list_leads
title: List Sales Navigator Leads
description: Read saved Sales Navigator leads, up to ``max_pages`` pages.

name: sales_nav_resolve_filters
title: Resolve Sales Navigator Filters
description:
Resolve free-text labels in Sales Navigator's visible typeaheads.

Ambiguous labels return candidates for clarification. One uncached batch
uses one Sales Navigator page visit.

name: sales_nav_search_accounts
title: Search Sales Navigator Accounts
description:
Read account results from a Sales Navigator search.

Pass the URL copied from your Sales Navigator account search after
applying filters. ``max_pages`` is capped. Each page is one navigation.
A page that does not advance, or a final URL that dropped a requested
filter, is not returned as a successful filtered page. It does not
save or contact accounts.

name: sales_nav_search_leads
title: Search Sales Navigator Leads
description:
Read lead results from a Sales Navigator search.

Pass the URL copied from your Sales Navigator lead search after applying
filters. ``max_pages`` is capped. Each page is one navigation and counts
toward the daily Sales Navigator navigation cap. A page that does not
advance, or a final URL that dropped a requested filter, is not returned
as a successful filtered page. Leads are structural: name, title,
company, location, the ``/sales/lead/`` URL, and the public ``/in/``
vanity when the card has one. It does not save or contact leads.

name: sales_nav_search_leads_by_filters
title: Search Sales Navigator Leads by Filters
description:
Search for leads with structured filters instead of a pasted URL.

Labels resolve through Sales Navigator's visible typeaheads, using the
locale-aware 30-day cache first. Uncached labels resolve through live
typeaheads. Ambiguous labels return candidates and stop before
searching so the caller can ask which one the banker meant. Up to
``max_results`` are returned, across at most three result pages.

name: sales_nav_status
title: Sales Navigator Status
description:
Check whether the signed-in LinkedIn session reaches Sales Navigator.

This only confirms whether a Sales Navigator route was reached. It
cannot confirm the subscription tier or trial dates.

name: search_companies
title: Search Companies
description: Search for companies on LinkedIn.

name: search_conversations
title: Search Conversations
description:
Search messages by keyword.

Rows are not clicked, so matches are not marked read. previews lists
each visible result. thread_id is null when the row has no thread
link; the list does not carry one, and reading it would select the
row. Open one result with get_conversation. Anchor references, when
the page has any, keep their normal handling.

limit.description:
Maximum number of search-result previews to return (1-50,
default 20).

name: search_jobs
title: Search Jobs
description:
Search for jobs on LinkedIn.

Returns job_ids that can be passed to get_job_details for full info.

LinkedIn is moving accounts to a redesigned job search, which keeps
only the keywords, date_posted and paging. It drops the filters
marked "Classic search only" and reports them in section_errors as
filters_dropped. When it drops the location or work type, search again
with them in the keywords ("remote python developer in Lyon") and keep
doing so; words such as "senior" or "internship" there narrow the
results too. Quotes do not make a phrase exact on that search.

location.description: Optional location filter (e.g., "San Francisco", "Remote"). Classic search only.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of result pages to load (1-10, default 3)

date_posted.description: Filter by posting date (past_hour, past_24_hours, past_week, past_month)

job_type.description: Filter by job type, comma-separated (full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, volunteer, internship, other). Classic search only.

experience_level.description: Filter by experience level, comma-separated (internship, entry, associate, mid_senior, director, executive). Classic search only.

work_type.description: Filter by work type, comma-separated (on_site, remote, hybrid). Classic search only.

easy_apply.description: Only show Easy Apply jobs (default false). Classic search only.

sort_by.description: Sort results (date, relevance). Classic search only.

name: search_people
title: Search People
description: Search for people on LinkedIn.

location.description:
Optional location filter, as LinkedIn's numeric geo URN
id (e.g., "103644278" for the United States). Plain-text place
names are silently ignored by LinkedIn and return unfiltered
results, so they are refused here. The id is the geoUrn value
in the URL of a LinkedIn people search filtered to that place;
without one, put the place in keywords instead.

network.description:
Optional connection-degree filter. Each element is one of
"F" (1st-degree), "S" (2nd-degree), "O" (3rd-degree and beyond).
Example: ["F"] to only return 1st-degree connections. A single
token ("F") or a comma-separated string ("F,S") is also
accepted, for clients that cannot transmit an array.

current_company.description:
Optional current-employer filter. LinkedIn's
currentCompany facet only filters on the numeric company URN id
(e.g. "1115" for SAP); plain company names are accepted by the
URL but ignored by LinkedIn and return the unfiltered result
set. Look up a company's URN via get_company_profile -- it is
exposed under references["about"]. For company-wide employee
demographics (location/education/function breakdown) plus a
slug-based lookup, use get_company_employees instead.

name: search_posts
title: Search Posts
description:
Search LinkedIn posts/content globally by keyword (the "Posts" tab).

Use this to catch informal hiring posts ("we're hiring", "Buscamos
...", "estamos contratando", "join our team") that often appear before
a formal job listing exists. This is global content search, distinct
from get_feed (your own home feed) and get_company_posts (one
company's page).

date_posted.description:
Optional recency filter. One of "past-24h",
"past-week", "past-month"; the "past_24_hours" / "past_week" /
"past_month" spellings used by search_jobs are accepted too.
Omit for any time.

max_pages.description:
Scroll depth as result "pages" of ~5 scrolls each
(1-10, default 3). Content search is an infinite scroll, so
this caps how far the page is scrolled rather than fetching
discrete pages.

content_type.description:
Optional "Content type" filter. One of
"documents" (PDFs and slide decks people upload), "images",
"videos", "live_videos", "job_posts". Omit for all posts.

name: send_message
title: Send Message
description:
Compose and send a new message to a LinkedIn user.

Profile-based targeting opens LinkedIn's compose flow. It is not a safe
reply path for an existing recruiter/InMail or messaging thread: it may
create a separate DM even after you inspect that thread with
get_conversation or search_conversations. To answer an existing thread,
including an InMail from someone who is not a connection, use
reply_to_conversation with the thread's id instead.

The recipient must be directly messageable from the profile page. If
LinkedIn does not expose a normal Message action, use connect_with_person
first, then retry send_message only after the connection request is
accepted. A ``status`` of ``enter_to_send_enabled`` means the account
has LinkedIn's "Press Enter to Send" preference on, which hides the Send
button; relay the returned instructions to the user, who switches it to
"Click Send to send" before retrying. The dry run (confirm_send False)
reports it too. Recipient authorization comes from validating one
recipient-specific Message action carrying the target URN, then following
its browser navigation and pinning the exact final route. Visible profile
links or recipient URNs in the composer are optional corroboration; any
contradiction fails closed. No Voyager or other private API is used. This
is a write operation when confirm_send is True.

``thread_id`` is present only on ``sent``: the conversation the
confirmed message was observed in, or null when the page stayed on
the compose route. ``retry_safe`` stays the authority for whether a
retry is safe.

linkedin_username.description: LinkedIn username of the recipient; a full profile URL is accepted too

message.description:
Message text. LF, CRLF and CR all end a line; an empty line
separates paragraphs and is kept. Whitespace-only lines count as
empty, and leading and trailing whitespace of the whole message
is removed, as LinkedIn does when sending. Tab, other control
characters, DEL, U+0085, U+2028 and U+2029 are refused.

confirm_send.description: Must be True to send the message

profile_urn.description:
Optional profile URN (e.g. ACoAAB...) to verify against
the URN exposed by the loaded profile before opening its Message
action. It never bypasses recipient verification. Obtain via
get_person_profile. Note: inbox may not always show all messages;
use search_conversations as a fallback.

dry_run.description: Fill the verified composer, return a preview, and discard the draft without sending.
